why: No owner research package covers tumble dryers and no teaching names them; they share physical dimensions (energy, sound, duration, moisture removal) with taught categories (dishwashers, dehumidifiers, air purifiers), so they test transfer of METHODS while category facts (fabric care, residual moisture, drum capacity) are new.
authorship: Requests authored by Claude (the developer) before any tumble-dryer page was read; plain consumer wording; not derived from any page.
research: Which tumble dryer is cheapest to run and still dries a family's washing properly?
I want a quiet tumble dryer because the utility room is next to the bedroom.
Is a heat pump tumble dryer worth it to reduce my bills?
reuse: We are a family of five and the dryer runs every day: which tumble dryer would use the least electricity and keep the noise down?
